newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber flat in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were generally lower in slow late trading on Tuesday with no fresh enquiries heard, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were at 54.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan against 54.75 U.S. cents/lb on the previous day.
"Prices are generally lower today and prices in other cities like Padang, Palembang and Surabaya are also in the same range as in Medan," said one trader.
Traders said the market lacked fresh enquiries while supply was ample.
